assertions.name: chart_fully_swept_no_overflow
assertions.source: every AME entry with A>=1 computed at mpf

description: v2 Wedderburn-spectral admissibility over the AME2020 chart at q_0 (EXPLORATORY). Per nucleus: the three Wedderburn block images of build_atom_nf's crossing sequence at 40-dps mpmath (no f64 overflow — closes v1's 38% gap). Tests: (F) Frobenius-cone membership tr_M(b_i a) >= 0 (prop:operator-selection-lp positivity); (P) spectral positivity of all blocks (the genuine SDP-strength per-nucleus criterion; the diagonal-lift solve_psd_operator_selection_sdp is LP-equivalent, so v1's suggestion would not have been a real upgrade). Includes the closed form sign(alt) = (-1)^T, T = 11A + A(A-1)/2 + Z.

findings: (F) is a LIGHT-CHART criterion: every Frobenius-cone member has A <= 26 (70 members; selective even within the light region — e.g. 4He, 12C in; 16O out).

(P) obeys the alt-parity selection rule exactly: allowed classes (A mod 4, Z parity) in {(0,even),(1,odd),(2,odd),(3,even)} — (0,even) contains the alpha-ladder (4He, 12C, 16O, 56Fe, 208Pb all spectrally positive) and (2,odd) the stable odd-odd family (2H, 6Li, 10B, 14N). The std-block condition then cuts the parity-allowed half (~1779) down to 717.

(P) is NOT simply the stable set (251): it admits 717 across A = 1-292. Exploratory — no production wiring; the criterion's physical meaning (if any) is the open question this probe feeds to the Delta_lambda work.
